selection_principles: Select the smallest set of sources that supplies semantic events plus the already accepted AmazingData numeric/bar observations.
Do not select direct exchange quotation or processed-market-data fallback merely because an official endpoint exists.
Treat CNINFO as optional issuer-document transport; this phase fails closed when the exchange source is insufficient rather than selecting a second transport class.
A public URL, HTTP 200, or successful SDK call is not a project permission for automated retrieval, retention, parsing, redistribution, or derived use.
Every selected source record is point-in-time eligible only when available_at <= as_of; missing, malformed, blocked, or conflicting evidence fails closed.

exact_project_use.retrieval: Retrieve only official lifecycle/event documents or their official index-to-document links for listing, suspension, resumption, risk-warning, delisting, and relisting facts.
exact_project_use.local_retention: Retain extracted event facts plus a provenance manifest and content hash. Retain full source bytes only after the class-specific project decision allows it.
exact_project_use.parsing: Parse event identity, event type, disclosure date, effective date/session, reason, and official announcement/record identity. Do not infer a missing effective date.
derived_facts: listing/suspension/risk-warning applicability for a target session
exact_project_use.redistribution: NONE_PLANNED; no external redistribution of source content or derived market-data artifacts in this phase.

terms_or_authorization_basis.missing_decision: Authorize or reject automated retrieval, local retention, parsing, internal research use, and derived event facts separately for the intended SSE, SZSE, and BSE document uses. BSE document access is not a market-data license.

canonical_locators.record_locator: Follow the official document link and record its announcement/document identity; the list page is not a substitute for the document.
Record the official notice identity, canonical document URL, and the issuer/code/date locator exposed by the notice.
Record the official announcement identity and document URL. A browser-rendered index may locate a document but cannot be relabelled as raw bytes.

retrieval_contract.request_identity: venue + canonical locator + normalized request/pagination parameters when a list request is used; store a request-parameters hash.
retrieval_contract.stable_record_identity: Official announcement/record ID is required. If the venue exposes no ID, use the canonical official document URL plus immutable content hash and exact source locator; do not invent an event ID.

representation.rule: Raw bytes and official PDF are distinct representations. rendered_dom may locate a source or preserve a browser observation, but it must remain labelled rendered_dom and cannot be claimed as raw bytes.

retrieval_contract.cache_and_version: Each retrieval gets a retrieval_id and content-addressed manifest. Never overwrite a prior retrieval; a changed document creates a new version and preserves the old hash.
retrieval_contract.availability_and_pit: Record retrieved_at_utc and evidence available_at. Select an event only when its effective interval covers the target session and available_at <= as_of.
fail_closed: HTTP failure, WAF/challenge, incomplete dynamic response, or an official document that cannot be identified
missing effective date/session, ambiguous security identity, or missing event type
same-event conflict at the same source tier
